answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files a saffron-stamped citation per epoch, citing prior work. Citations are logged in an ivory ledger, and a false one burns it. Each citation costs 45 credits; filings emit a signal auditors check. 1,000 fakes file 1,000 citations per epoch: 45,000 credits plus 70,000 locked, versus 40,000 max rewards. Rented citations fail: the ledger exposes untouched work. An honest agent pays 45 once, bond kept.
